remarks: Welcome to this inviting 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo for rent in Stamford's desirable Mid-Town neighborhood, where modern updates meet everyday convenience. Just minutes from downtown, you'll be close to an array of restaurants, shopping, parks, and entertainment, with quick access to I-95, Route 1, and the Metro-North station for an easy commute.  Step inside to discover an airy, open-concept layout featuring 9-foot ceilings, recessed lighting, and elegant crown molding that create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The well-appointed kitchen offers plenty of cabinet storage and expansive counter space, making meal preparation both practical and enjoyable.  The spacious living area easily accommodates a home office or reading nook, while the generously sized bedroom features a custom-designed walk-in closet for exceptional storage and organization. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, assigned parking, and a private basement storage area.  Offering the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location, this move-in-ready rental is an excellent opportunity to enjoy everything Stamford has to offer right outside your door.
